An automatic computing system is a device with which certain instructions can be given, and which will then carry out these instructions automatically. The device requires a central arithmetic part, a central control part, a memory that stores both instructions and numerical data, and input and output organs.

The IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic (IEEE 754) is a technical standard for floating-point computation which defines arithmetic formats, interchange formats, rounding rules, operations, and exception handling including binary32 and binary64.

UTF-8 encodes UCS characters as a varying number of octets, where the number of octets, and the value of each, depend on the integer value assigned to the character in ISO/IEC 10646. US-ASCII values do not appear otherwise in a UTF-8 encoded character stream.

CS2023 organizes computer science knowledge into core areas including Algorithms and Complexity, Architecture and Organization, Discrete Structures, Foundations of Programming Languages, Operating Systems, Parallel and Distributed Computing, Software Development Fundamentals, Software Engineering, and Security.

Ownership is Rust's most unique feature and has deep implications for the rest of the language. It enables Rust to make memory safety guarantees without needing a garbage collector: each value in Rust has an owner, there can only be one owner at a time, and when the owner goes out of scope, the value will be dropped. Objects are Python's abstraction for data. All data in a Python program is represented by objects or by relations between objects. Every object has an identity, a type, and a value. Special method names (__init__, __iter__, __enter__, __exit__, __get__) define the Python data model protocols.

An ECMAScript agent consists of execution contexts, an execution context stack, a running execution context, a set of job queues (macrotask and microtask queues), and a heap of objects linked through prototype chains and lexical environments.

One of TypeScript's core principles is that type checking focuses on the shape that values have, sometimes called duck typing or structural subtyping. TypeScript's type system is erased completely at compile time and introduces zero runtime overhead.

C# is a modern, object-oriented, and type-safe programming language running on the Common Language Runtime (CLR), unifying value types (structs, Span<T>) and reference types (classes, records), generics without type erasure, LINQ, and task-based asynchronous programming.

The Java Virtual Machine executes class files using class loaders, a bytecode verifier, an interpreter, a Just-In-Time compiler, and automatic garbage collection under the Java Memory Model (JMM) happens-before relation, complemented in Java 21 by lightweight Virtual Threads.

Go is a general-purpose systems language designed with structural interfaces, explicit error values, garbage collection, and CSP-inspired concurrency via lightweight goroutines multiplexed onto OS threads and typed communication channels.

Kotlin enforces null safety in its type system by distinguishing nullable and non-null references at compile time, and provides structured concurrency through suspend functions, CoroutineScope, Dispatchers, and cold asynchronous Flows.

Swift combines protocol-oriented programming, copy-on-write value types, deterministic memory management via Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), and compile-time data-race safety using Sendable types and actor isolation.

The relational model represents all data as mathematical n-ary relations manipulated through relational algebra and declarative SQL queries. PostgreSQL implements Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC), Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), and cost-based query optimization.

SQLite is a self-contained, serverless, zero-configuration, transactional SQL database engine in the public domain that implements B-tree storage, ACID transactions via rollback journals or Write-Ahead Logging, CTEs, and window functions.

The shell is a command language interpreter that executes commands read from standard input or a file, performing parameter expansion, command substitution, arithmetic expansion, word splitting, pathname expansion, and redirection across pipelines.

HTML defines the semantic structure and Document Object Model (DOM) of web documents, while CSS defines the cascade, specificity, inheritance, box model, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive container queries for visual and accessible presentation.

JSON is a lightweight, text-based, language-independent data interchange format defining six structural tokens, strings, numbers, booleans, null, objects, and arrays encoded in UTF-8. YAML 1.2 is a strict superset of JSON adding anchors, aliases, and multi-document streams.
